h1: Photo Booth Hire Harpenden: Marquees, Clubs and Halls
intro: Plenty of Harpenden celebrations happen at home, under a marquee on the back lawn, and just as many take place in the town's clubs, halls and hotels. Our team brings the booth, an attendant, props and a print design made for your day, and we handle the build and pack-down ourselves. Packages from £239.

sections.heading: Putting a booth in a garden marquee
paragraphs: A marquee party is a lovely setting for a photo booth, and three things make it work. First, a solid, level floor: boarding or staging rather than bare grass, because a booth on a soft lawn can tilt and the camera loses its framing. Second, a reliable 13-amp socket that is not shared with the caterers' urns and ovens, ideally from a dedicated supply run by your marquee company. Third, a covered position away from open sides, so rain or a damp evening breeze never reaches the screen or printer.

Most of our booths fit comfortably in a corner of a standard marquee. The Inflatable Booth is the exception: it needs a 4 by 4 metre floor, at least 3 metres of headroom and two sockets, so check those with your marquee supplier before choosing it.
list: Boarded or staged floor, not grass
Dedicated 13A socket within reach of the booth
Covered spot away from open walls and doorways
Inflatable Booth: 4m x 4m floor, 3m headroom, two sockets

sections.heading: Harpenden, its villages and the roads we use
paragraphs: Harpenden lies in Hertfordshire between St Albans and Luton, and we cover the whole town, from the centre and the common out to Batford and Kinsbourne Green. The neighbouring villages of Redbourn and Wheathampstead are part of the same easy run, and we are equally happy to continue on to St Albans or Luton for your next event.

We reach the area along the A1081 or from junctions 9 and 10 of the M1. If your corporate guests are coming out from London, Harpenden station on Thameslink makes the town a convenient choice for a team evening, and nobody needs to worry about driving home afterwards.

sections.heading: Clubs, halls and hotels around the town
paragraphs: Away from private gardens, Harpenden's events are spread across a familiar mix of venues. Sports and cricket clubs host birthday parties, end-of-season dinners and family celebrations in their pavilions and clubhouses. Golf clubs take weddings, anniversary meals and proms, while hotels in and around the town handle corporate dinners and larger receptions.

Village halls in Redbourn, Wheathampstead and the surrounding area remain the first choice for christenings, children's parties and milestone birthdays, and school halls are used for discos, fundraisers and leavers' events. We ask each venue about access, power and finish times before your date so the evening runs smoothly.

sections.heading: Booths Harpenden hosts tend to book
paragraphs: For marquee and golf club weddings, the Magic Mirror is a popular centrepiece: a full-length interactive mirror with on-screen animations, a DSLR camera and prints for every guest, plus a guest book for messages. At a large garden party or a summer celebration with room to spare, the Inflatable Booth glows in a colour matched to your theme and fits up to ten people at once.

Cricket club birthdays and school hall discos are where the LCD SlimPod shines. It is our most affordable booth, removes the background automatically without a green screen, and adds virtual props, GIFs and boomerangs. For a product launch or a staff social, the GIF Booth delivers animated clips by email or QR code with a custom branded overlay.

sections.heading: Planning notes for different celebrations
paragraphs: Weddings get the most from a booth that opens during the evening reception, once the formal photographs are done and guests have time on their hands. Corporate events benefit from a branded overlay and an early decision on whether guests want prints or social-ready clips. Proms are busiest in the first hour, so schedule the booth from arrival. Birthday hosts often prefer it running from the moment guests walk in, and Christmas parties work well with the booth placed close to the dance floor so it never feels out of the way. Send us the timings and we will suggest a hire length to fit.

sections.heading: Arriving, parking and building the booth
paragraphs: For a home marquee we need space on the drive or the road outside to unload, then a clear path to the tent, which helps if garden gates are wide enough for a trolley. Clubs, hotels and halls usually have car parks close to the entrance, and we will move the vehicle once the kit is inside. Upstairs rooms are fine for our slimmer booths if you warn us in advance.

Our attendant allows 45 to 60 minutes to build before your hire window starts, and that setup time is free. One standard socket powers every booth apart from the Inflatable Booth, which needs two. Every booking includes unlimited sessions, props, LED lighting, a custom print template, digital copies and public liability insurance, and we are rated 5 stars on Trustpilot.

faqs.q: Where will you park for a party at a private house in Harpenden?
faqs.a: On your drive if there is room, or on the road outside while we unload. We then carry the booth through to the marquee, so let us know about side gates, steps or a long walk across the garden. Clubs and hotels normally have their own car park.

faqs.q: Can the booth go upstairs in a clubhouse or hotel?
faqs.a: Yes, if we know in advance. The LCD SlimPod, GIF Booth and Retro Pod are easy to carry up a staircase. For the Magic Mirror or Inflatable Booth, we recommend a ground-floor space or a building with a lift.

faqs.q: Do you charge for travel to Harpenden?
faqs.a: Delivery and setup are included. If any travel contribution ever applies to a far-flung venue, it is shown on the quote up front. Harpenden, Redbourn, Wheathampstead, Batford and Kinsbourne Green are all within our regular area.

faqs.q: Can the booth stand on the grass inside our marquee?
faqs.a: We would rather it did not. Grass is rarely level and can be soft or damp, which unsettles the booth and the camera. Ask your marquee company for boarding or a small stage panel under the booth position, along with a reliable 13-amp socket nearby.

faqs.q: What happens if it rains at our garden party?
faqs.a: As long as the booth is set up in a covered part of the marquee, away from open sides, rain is not a problem. Our attendant will check the position on arrival and, if the weather turns, move the booth a little further inside if there is space.
